lessons_used: Evidence is still thin across all kinds of changes, as only one test has been completed so far.

candidates.title: Defer Sign-In After Pet Selection
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to occur after pet selection so users experience their pet before creating an account.
candidates.why: Sign-in has drop-off and support received 8 emails regarding missing/reset pets when signing in prior to adoption.

sign_in.headline: Save Your New Desktop Companion
sign_in.body: Create or log into your account to store your pet safe in the cloud.

guard.reason: Reordering sign_in step within onboarding is explicitly permitted.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails and sign-in drop-off; reordering flow requires app release.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Preview Stage
candidates.change: Redesign pick_friend with a stage layout showing live animated pet previews.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has low completion (60.9%) and median time of 89s; visual previews help users decide faster.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Overview Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated onboarding screen right before home intro explaining desktop mouse gestures and hotkeys.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or interact with the desktop pet after setup.

new_controls_overview.headline: How to Interact With Your Pet
new_controls_overview.body: Right-click your desktop pet anytime to access hide, summon, and pet settings.

guard.reason: Adding a new controls overview screen before home_intro is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Low confidence due to prior lesson showing -5.6% lift for finish/new_screen.

candidates.title: Photo Quality Verification Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Insert a custom photo preview step to validate photo clarity before custom pet creation.
candidates.why: 3 support emails cited custom pet generation failing or producing bad visual results.

upload_photos.hint: Bright, clear lighting ensures your custom pet is generated correctly.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_photo_checker']

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Generation Waiting Progress Tips
candidates.change: Display rotating tips and desktop pet trivia while waiting for pet assets to assemble.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s and median 201s, leading to drop-offs during processing.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet's New Home...
waiting.body: Your pet is packing its bags and getting ready to move onto your desktop!

guard.reason: Modifying waiting screen information and progress is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extreme wait times (2336s mean) at home generation step.

candidates.title: Account Persistence Warning Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit sign-in hint explaining that using the same account method restores existing pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails were received about pets missing or resetting after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Always log in with the same account method to preserve your saved pets and progress.

guard.reason: Adding account persistence hints to sign_in is permitted.

candidates.score_note: High support email volume (8 emails) and low implementation cost.

candidates.title: Path Selection Reward Incentive
candidates.change: Offer an exclusive starter accessory badge when choosing an onboarding path.
candidates.why: 23.8% drop-off at choose_path step with a high mean completion time of 514s.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Path & Claim Starter Item
choose_path.body: Pick how you want to create your pet and receive a free pet hat accessory!

guard.reason: text in 'choose_path.body' talks about price or money

candidates.title: Desktop Ready Notification Alert
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification alerts so users are notified when pet generation finishes.
candidates.why: Users wait over 3 minutes on average during generation and abandon the app while running in the background.

waiting.hint: You will receive a desktop notification as soon as your pet is ready!

guard.reason: Adding notification settings during the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Helps recover users abandoning during long background pet generation.

candidates.title: Split Layout Adoption Certificate Confirmation
candidates.change: Reformat adoption certificate into a split card layout with side-by-side pet summary and confirmation.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion rate is 60.9%; a side-by-side summary streamlines final confirmation.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Review your pet companion details and sign to welcome them home.

guard.reason: Reformatting the adoption certificate layout while retaining its core function is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step loses the most users (39.1%), though support email evidence is missing.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Placement Launch Guidance
candidates.change: Update home_intro text with clear instructions on where to look on screen if the pet icon is minimized.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pet not showing on desktop or app failing to open visibly after setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Look at the taskbar tray or screen corner. Click the tray icon if your pet is hiding.

guard.reason: Updating copy on home_intro is allowed as it is part of onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Simple copy change addressing 3 support emails about hidden desktop icons.

held_by_harm_budget: Desktop Pet Generation Waiting Progress Tips
lessons_next: Evidence is still thin across all kinds of changes, as no category has at least 2 tests yet.
Predictions have been consistently too high compared to actual noise-corrected results.
No clear effect was seen for sign_in, reorder changes.
Adding a new_screen to finish controls reduced completion, but evidence for this kind of change is still thin.
